
   Objection was raised.

  Levin of Johnson moved to suspend the rules to consider
amendment H–1003.

   Roll call was requested by Levin of Johnson and Matson of Polk.

   The motion to suspend the rules lost.

   Hora of Washington moved that the bill be read a last time now and
placed upon its passage which motion prevailed and the bill was read
a last time.

   On the question “Shall the bill pass?” (H.F. 117)
